summary: [Google Calendar] events: Push: events.watch/calendarList.watch creates a web_hook channel (HTTPS address, optional X-Goog-Channel-Token for spoof-resistance, optional expiration; 7-day TTL, re-watch to renew). Poll: events.list with syncToken (incremental); HTTP 410 means token expired -> drop token, full resync. Sync tokens are bound to the query that issued them; showDeleted=true + singleEvents=false on full list for tombstones.
